children: European cars are engineered tightly, and they’re unforgiving of guesswork. Autobahn Werks exists to work on them the way the factory intended — with the right tools, the right procedures and technicians who know the platform cold.

That means we find the actual fault instead of throwing parts at a symptom, we torque and code to spec, and we tell you what can wait and what can’t. Precision is the point — and it’s what keeps a well-built machine feeling built.

pages.name: About
pages.seoDescription: Who Autobahn Werks is, what we do and the people behind the work.

children.class: mx-auto grid w-full max-w-5xl items-center gap-10 @3xl:grid-cols-2 @3xl:gap-16

attrs.alt: A European performance sedan in a clean service bay under focused light

children: We opened Autobahn Werks because European drivers deserved a shop that treats their cars as seriously as the engineers who built them — dealer-level capability, without the dealer runaround.

Everyone here is factory-trained on the marques we service, working with the same diagnostic equipment and genuine parts the dealership uses. The difference is the relationship: you book by name, you get a straight answer, and you keep the car that made you fall for it in the first place.

children.class: mx-auto flex w-full max-w-5xl flex-col gap-10

children: We confirm the real cause on the factory interface before recommending a repair — no parts-cannon, no guesswork.
Torque values, fluids, coding and procedures follow the manufacturer — the way precision engineering expects to be handled.
You get a clear picture of what needs doing now and what can safely wait, so you decide with the full story.
